# `meta/editorconfig`

<!-- Generated by `pnpm build:docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Editor-agnostic indentation, charset and newline settings so diffs stay clean across machines.

**Provides:** `meta:editorconfig`

## Files it writes

- `.editorconfig`

## Use it

```bash
atarashi new my-app --add meta/editorconfig
atarashi add meta/editorconfig
```
